question_state: Open; no researcher scientific closure inferred
answer_mask_policy: Only semantic answer tokens. Leading isolated whitespace moved to known teacher-forcing prefix; merged content tokens retained; complete model input IDs unchanged; EOS excluded. Free generation gets no gold prefix.
spectrum_scope: Independent903-biography-family centered pre-finalnorm reference,32768positions. Generic94-family reference failed .7 stability and remains preserved.
scheduling: Same data/order/actual quotas/globalbatch/updates per seed across all arms. Source/entity assignment units; final1vs8 presentations recency-paired when possible. Fresh same-seed initialization per independent scale.

generation.stop: First completed nonempty answer line or nativeEOS

evaluation: Full AB+128 nevertrained sentinel original+two unseen question templates at baseline/afterA/afterB; original-answer content NLL and independent128paragraph LM NLL; fixed192-fact active/off/keys-only/values-only controls with identically batched baseline.
main_contrasts: A afterB-minus-afterA retention jointly with B acquisition
statistical_policy: Fact-level both-unseen-question success primary; original accuracy and content-token NLL separate. source-family paired5000-bootstrap CI, each seed/cohort/1vs8/phase separately; uncertainty outputs separate and conservative lower/upper bounds. No CI overconfidence from question replication.
teacher_cohorts: Two fixed screening views closed correct preferred, otherwise two source-conditioned correct; student notbothcorrect and no unresolved. Metadata and all exclusion outputs retained. No heldout questions used for eligibility.
scale_gate: First finish complete all-arm pilot, then expand all arms equally using measured end-to-end time/storage, never best-arm scores. Maximum actual balanced eligible<=20000; preserve missing/failed arms. Reuse baseline eligibility for previously screened facts.
natural_frequency: Unknown. Controlled1vs8 supervision is not Qwen pretraining exposure.
limits: One numeric birth-year relation; automatically extracted source spans,112agent fact sample reviews,0human review; template paraphrases. Frozen backbone with added shared parameters, not original-model knowledge or gradient-free dynamic writing.

penalty_calibration.l2_rule: lambda_head * head_dim/d_model; isotropic expected energy matching, not guaranteed observed gradient matching
penalty_calibration.interpretation: DEV recommendation only; head/random share exactly one lambda, L2 coefficient follows the stated isotropic rule. Retain actual achieved ratios and cap failures.
